query:
SELECT MIN(r.started_at_utc) AS "started_at_utc!: String",
                   r.zone AS "zone!: String"
              FROM canonical_cycling_session AS s
              JOIN canonical_bike_plus_ride AS r ON r.session = s.id
             WHERE s.kind = 'test'
             GROUP BY s.id
             ORDER BY MIN(r.started_at_utc)
